Trazodone- fuck whatcha heard
For those that dont know a little background info. Trazodone is a antidepressant/sleep aid similar to nefazodone but these drugs are in a weird little category of their own they are not MAOIs or SSRIs.  For me, 50 mg is a good starting dose for recreational or medical purposes.
So most of what I read about snorting trazodone said 'DONT DO IT NEVER SNORT TRAZODONE' even though its water soluble and therefore should be ok to insufflate.
I snorted ~25mg (a quarter of a 100mg pill) and felt the relaxing, sedating, feeling one would expect from about an hour after a higher oral dose immediately. It was a bit rough going down.
